title: epidendrum ramosum var. angustifolium
intro: Epidendrum ramosum var. angustifolium, commonly known as the "Ramoso," is a type of orchid species in the Orchidaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Epidendrum ramosum var. angustifolium include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
